facts.note: At nine, the temple bell; Aurèle had everyone show their watches; Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell. Same timepiece and relation.
Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch; he went to the hall for his cigar case from his coat; Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he returned.
At the temple striking ten during the game, the salon clock showed five minutes to ten, and he remarked on it to Madame.

added.why: Asserts the atelier regulator stopped at the moment of Aurèle's death, so the stopping of that clock is tied in order to the death. A detective gets a time-linked relation the sheet does not give, though the death time itself stays unknown.
